narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Case File"**

The portfolio is a case file: a stack of folders, each one a piece of evidence that can be opened. The dark slate ground is the cabinet, the frost sheets are the papers inside, and the single teal accent marks what can be acted on. Every proof (CI results, the playground, the CV, contact) is a folder with a tab; as the visitor scrolls, the tabs climb to the top and dock into the nav bar, so the stack the page opened with becomes the navigation that stays. Evidence leads and the interface steps back.

The voice is sober, editorial and trustworthy. One serif, Erode, carries every size; scale does the work that weight, rules and ornament do elsewhere. Density is calm: wide margins, one dominant thing per screen, a small number of large real pictures (screenshots of the site's own pages). The one live thing is the folder stack itself, driven by real CI numbers.
keyCharacteristics: Dark slate cabinet (`case-slate`) with frost sheets (`frost`) laid on it.
Trapezoid folder tabs are the signature shape: they are the nav, the folder labels and the primary button's silhouette.
One typeface (Erode), tight tracking at display sizes, five size steps.
One accent (`teal-ink`), used for the primary action and links.
Flat: no gradients, no shadows at rest; depth comes from tone steps between slate and frost.
Same nav tabs, same order, same positions on every page.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only chromatic color in the interface. It marks the action and verification; it is never a surface fill beyond its wash. (The playground shop's per-category art gradients are the one exception, as before.)

rules.name: The Cabinet and Sheet Rule
rules.body: Dark slate is for structure (nav, hero, folder bands, heads, closing, footer); frost and white are for reading. Never set long text on a dark band.

rules.name: The Tab Colour Rule
rules.body: A resting tab is `folder-slate`; the active tab is `case-slate`, the same tone as the head band below it, so the active tab and its page read as one folder.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Erode for everything; two or three sizes do the visible work, one very large and one small. Never a second family, never monospace.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase label above a heading. The folder tab is the label.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; hover changes colour, never elevation.

dos: keep the tab set, order and x positions identical on every page.
build every new proof as a folder: a tab, a band, one real number or picture.
use real screenshots of this site for imagery; they live in `web/public/shots/`.
use Teal Ink for the one action and verification only.
set running text in Case Slate on frost and keep every text colour AA on its ground.
put new text in `web/src/i18n/translations.ts`; es and en stay equal.
keep a visible focus state and full keyboard operation on every control.
draw colours from the variables in `web/src/css/tokens.css`.
donts: add a second typeface or any monospace.
add gradients, glass or shadows at rest to the interface.
put an eyebrow label above a heading; the tab is the label.
separate sections with hairlines or outlined boxes; use space or a tone step.
set long text on a dark band or text below AA on any ground.
give the same tab different positions or colours on different pages.
hardcode hex values in components; use the tokens.
